newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-CRUSE TAKES ONE-SHOT LEAD INTO FINAL ROUND.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-CRUSE TAKES ONE-SHOT LEAD INTO FINAL ROUND.

text.p: South Africa's Andre Cruse, virtually blind in one eye three years ago, shot a level par 72 in driving rain on Saturday to take a one-shot lead into the final round of the Players' championship.
Cruse, who had the sight in his left eye radically improved after the last of two cataract operations in late 1995, was on 208 after 54 holes.

He dropped a shot at the par-three second and collected a birdie three at the ninth. Otherwise he reeled off a sequence of pars in the difficult conditions and said later that he owed his performance to a much-improved short game.

Playing partner Nico van Rensburg had moved to the top of the leaderboard after a birdie two at the 12th but he then dropped shots over the final two holes for a 73 -- and a share of second place on 209 with fellow South African Warren Schutte.
Overnight leader Jeff Hawkes struggled in the steady wind and rain, slipping down the leaderboard into a fourway tie for seventh place on 212 after a 77.
